title: PH60404: Microprocessor And Its Applications
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Microprocessor architecture, Address space and its partitions, Assembling
Language programming, Interfacing ROM and RAM, Input/output devices,
Interfacing I/O devices to microprocessor, programmable peripheral interface,
programmable interrupt controller, Development of Monitor program. Sensors and
transducers, analogue signal processing, multiplexes and demultiplexes, sampleand-hold circuits, ACD and DAC devices, Interrupt facilities of
microprocessors, handshaking techniques, interrupt driven and dedicated
controllers. Development of algorithms, Programming techniques, interfacing
feedback loops. System development requirements, Overall system designs,
hardware design, software design, typical examples.
